primary_style_anchors.purpose: Dedicated sheets: primary character identity, proportions, materials, lighting and cute/badass phone readability. Never replace their designs.
Exact Act I Hoard Dragon identity: wingless/coiled violet-obsidian-gold. Original malformed tail requires real redraw; not a new winged design.
Existing Verdant Mirror guardian identity and tree/water/mirror treatment.
Existing Furnace Regent ironwork/forge identity; not a generic golem.
Five accepted Wanderer identities; matching heavy-two-hand art under art/sprites/poses constrains poses.
Established Patch/Ilex/Sera identity and portrait presentation; not substitutes for merchant anatomy.
Compatible equipment/material style only; current twelve family IDs and accepted held exports override labels.
